name: Self-hosted email archive with full-text search

mentions.name: Self-hosted email archive with full-text search
mentions.description: A self-hosted web app for archiving personal email. It ingests .eml files, stores the text in Postgres for full-text search (tsvector/tsquery), and can retrieve an email's entire thread using recursive queries.
mentions.problem: None of the existing email archive options the author tried were very good, lacking features like full-thread retrieval.
mentions.source_excerpt: I just finished a small personal project: a self-hosted web app which stores and indexes my archived emails. None of the existing options I tried were very good so I made my own. A simple Rails app that ingests .eml files and stores the text in postgres for full-text search.
